prompt: A mobile e-commerce home page screen design (portrait phone UI, 390px wide layout), for the lifting-strap brand ONE PERCENT (tagline BETTER DAILY). The whole screen is an engineering drawing sheet on near-black #0B0B0C with a faint graphite drafting grid. Regions top to bottom: (1) a thin header strip drawn as a technical title block with hairline white rules: the "1%" circle logo with a purple arc at left, small wide-tracked caps "MENU" and "CART (0)" at right. (2) An oversized heavy Montserrat all-caps headline filling the width: "BUILT TO THE LAST 1%". (3) The hero: one black lifting strap from the first reference image laid perfectly flat and horizontal across the full width, photographed from directly above, with thin white leader lines running out to three small caps callouts: "SILICONE ANTI-SLIP GRIP", "5MM NEOPRENE PADDING", "DOUBLE D-RING CUFF"; one purple #9B5DE5 dimension line with arrowheads spans the strap, labelled "30CM" in large heavy numerals. (4) A small title-block row of cells: "DWG 1P-LS-BLK", "REV A", "SCALE 1:1", "PAIR". (5) Anchored at the bottom: price "$39.95 AUD" at left in white, and a full-width flat rectangular purple #9B5DE5 button with black caps text "ADD TO CART". Style: precise technical drawing, white hairlines, wide-tracked 11px caps labels against huge numerals, square corners, no cards, no rounded buttons, no gradients, no glow, no people. Use the logo and colours from the second reference image. Crisp, premium, high contrast UI screenshot. [Magnific Nano Banana Pro 2k 9:16; refs: spec sheet, packaging blueprint]
approval_note: Delegated by Hunter ('no preference'), chosen by Claude for product-first honesty and a hero that a real flat-lay photo can replace. Drop the stray '#9B5DE5' label text.
